name: Map
description: An OpenStreetMap map that shows a location from another field (an address or coordinates) and, optionally, lets people drop a pin.

props.name: zoom
props.label: Zoom
props.description: 1 shows the world, 15 a few streets, 19 a building.

props.name: pick
props.label: Let people drop a pin
props.description: Click, tap or press Enter to place the pin; the field stores its coordinates. Off: the map only shows the location.

props.name: show_coordinates
props.label: Show coordinates
props.description: Latitude and longitude under the map (editable when people can drop a pin).

props.name: markers
props.label: Markers
props.description: Places to mark: a list of { lat, lng, label }. Bind it to a data table or an API reference (Dynamic) to plot rows; at most 500.

context.name: location
context.label: Location
context.description: The field to show on the map: an Address field, coordinates ({lat, lng}) or "lat,lng" text. The map centres on it and shows a pin.

output.description: The location as "lat,lng"; <key>_lat and <key>_lng are numbers

accessibility.keyboard: Tab to the map: arrow keys pan, + / - zoom. With pin dropping on, Enter or Space drops the pin at the centre (a crosshair marks it). The Latitude and Longitude inputs set the pin exactly; Clear removes it.
